provenance_semantics: manifest.json records the bytes of every campaign artifact as of execution and is never rewritten. This supplement records the artifacts whose current bytes differ, with the reason for each. An artifact absent from this list must still match the executed manifest exactly. Protected artifacts - experimental inputs, outputs, recorded results, and any pinned protocol base - may never appear here; tools/campaign_current_state.py rejects such an entry.
nonclaims: does not change any recorded result or boundary
does not upgrade any assurance dimension
declared drift is documentation/tooling only, never experimental evidence
